hashAlgorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over 240x240 RGBA bytes in row-major order, uint32 multiplication via Math.imul
notes: These hashes are generated from the pure JS software RGBA framebuffer, not screenshots of the physical LCD or browser CSS display.
The font, geometric constants, title/foreground palette, didactic placement and 21-character clipping are copied from firmware C. Pressed controls affect only didactic tint, no screen navigation.
Only the dark-magenta background differs in Soft and Gentle. Original is the RGB565-expanded firmware color.
CSS scales a fixed 240x240 logical canvas with image-rendering pixelated; the source bitmap never grows with devicePixelRatio.
The operator must select a visually preferred background before WEB-02 is accepted; no production-browser visual test has been performed during this candidate implementation.
WEB-03 operator-approved direction: default Gentle, with more vivid magenta and less gray. Foreground, font, geometry and all C-source colors remain unchanged.
